environment.description: Production Django application deployed on EC2 behind an NLB. The application uses django-waffle for feature flags but the waffle tables have not been populated. The FEATURE_LEGACY_JWT_VALIDATION setting defaults to True in settings.py. The JWT_SECRET (SECRET_KEY) is a 64-character hex string used for both Django sessions and JWT HS256 validation. PyJWT version 2.6.0 installed. No request filtering or token inspection at the load balancer layer.
